title: data/photosets.json
description: The photosets added to the gallery, newest first, written by hand. generate_photo_feed.py builds feed-photos.xml from them and copies the newest into KR_NEW_PHOTOS (js/shared-components.js), which marks its frames New.

_help.description: How to add a set; read by people, ignored by code.

date.description: The day the set was added (YYYY-MM-DD): the feed item's date.

place.description: Where it was taken, as it ends "<count> new photographs from <place>."
